name: Field Doctor-Style Chicken Paella (Low FODMAP)
ingredients:
680 g Chicken
465 g Whole grain rice
1 x 400 g tin Plum Tomato
1 3/4 Green Peppers
160 g Spinach
1 3/4 medium Carrots
125 g Extra Virgin Olive Oil
100 g Fennel
1/2 Red Peppers
80 g Peas
80 g Green Beans
60 g Tomato Puree [tomato]
3/4 Lemon Juice
5 tbsp Mixed Herbs
3 tbsp Parsley Flat
3/4 tbsp Tapioca Starch
1 1/4 tsp Chicken Stock (Chicken Extract, Chicken Fat, Salt], Sundried Tomatoes [Sundried tomatoes, Salt], Lemon Zest, Sweet Noble Paprika, Smoked Paprika
pinch of Tamari [water, SOYA beans, sea salt], Chive Rings, Sea Salt, Black Pepper, Fennel Ground, Saffron
directions:
1. Brown chicken: Season chicken and brown in olive oil in a wide pan; set aside.

2. Sofrito veg: Soften green pepper, red pepper, carrot and fennel with chives. Stir in tomato puree, chopped tomato, sundried tomatoes, sweet paprika, smoked paprika, saffron and fennel ground.

3. Rice: Add wholegrain rice and toast 1–2 minutes. Pour in chicken stock, water, lemon juice, lemon zest and tamari. Nestle chicken back in with peas and green beans. Simmer uncovered until rice is tender and liquid mostly absorbed (add splash of water if dry).

4. Finish: Fold spinach through at the end. Rest 5 minutes. Scatter parsley and herb mix.
 
Cool, portion into 8, refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze; reheat until piping hot.
description:
Ingredients: Chicken, Water, Whole grain rice, Chopped Tomato, Green Pepper, Spinach, Carrot, Extra Virgin Olive Oil...

Home recreation inspired by Field Doctor Chicken Paella (Low FODMAP) (~405 g ready meal). Scaled to 8 portions. Not an official Field Doctor recipe. https://www.fielddoctor.co.uk/products/chicken-paella
notes:
REVERSE-ENGINEERED from Field Doctor published ingredients for personal home cooking only. Official meal is Monash Low FODMAP certified at single-serve size.

Scaling notes
Scaled for 8 portions from Field Doctor single serve (~405 g x 8 = 3240 g).
Unlabelled amounts inferred from UK descending-weight ingredient order (each item <= the one above and >= the one below; leftover mass shared on that basis, not equally).
Spoon measures use ingredient density (g per tsp) then round to kitchen fractions.
Amounts above 50 g are rounded to the nearest 5 g for cooking convenience.
Sweet peppers ~140 g each; carrots ~80 g; sweet potatoes ~130 g; courgettes ~175 g; aubergines ~250 g; swedes ~800 g; plum tomatoes = 400 g tins; lemon ~45 ml / lime ~30 ml juice.
Duplicate label ingredients merged (higher amount kept).
Liquid for home cooking: cook rice, quinoa, pasta, noodles and potatoes in water as you normally would (salt the water; drain where appropriate). For sauces, braises and stir-fry glazes, add water or stock gradually until the consistency is right — do not try to measure the ready-meal's residual water.
Low FODMAP: no onion or garlic bulbs — use chives / green tops only. Inspired recreation from Field Doctor ingredients, not an official recipe.
Chives listed in grams to match fresh packs (e.g. Waitrose Cooks' Ingredients Chives, 20 g).
Ready-meal residual water was ~544 g (inferred ~16.80% from list order) and is not listed as an ingredient.
Extra Virgin Olive Oil is kept as an ingredient on this recipe because the ready meal is relatively oil-rich (or pesto-style); still fry/roast in extra virgin olive oil as directed.
